# Forward clock change in variable-offset zone · 1 of 3

[Decision profiles](../README.md) · [Method and other cases](README.md) · [Clerk procedure](../../../handbook/governance/emergency-and-reminders.md)

**Given.** Quiet local time [21:00, 03:15) crosses midnight; zone changes from UTC+01 to UTC+02 at 2026-03-29 01:00 UTC, and returns to UTC+01 at 2026-10-25 01:00 UTC. An outgoing reminder is still useful at the deadline itself. No additional fallback. All input/output instants are UTC except the labelled local preview.

Use the row inputs with this profile. Compare every expected output at the indicated cutoff. Case numbers are local to this profile.
